description: Defines fixed-size structures and classes for HTTP/2 protocol frames and their fields, including constructors, size methods, and operators for comparison and output.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, including size, type, flags, and stream ID, with methods for flag management and string representation.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Represents the priority fields of an HTTP/2 stream, including dependency, weight, and exclusivity.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents the RST_STREAM frame's error code.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Represents a SETTINGS frame parameter and its value.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Represents the promised stream ID in a PUSH_PROMISE frame.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Represents the opaque bytes in a PING frame.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Represents the last stream ID and error code in a GOAWAY frame.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the window size increment in a WINDOW_UPDATE frame.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Represents the fixed size portion of an ALTSVC frame.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the stream ID of a stream whose priority is being updated.

methods.name: EncodesSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the encoded structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the structure for debugging.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for the structure.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for the structure.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the structure to an ostream for logging.
